dct_description_sm: This polygon shapefile contains statistics on households with cellular phones from the 2010 Census of Argentina. The census information was collected on October 27, 2010 by Direccion Nacional de Estadistica y Censos (Argentina). The questionnaire and survey report for this census are included with this download.
These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
